newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: New Zealand to set pension white paper on July 7.
newsitem.headline: New Zealand to set pension white paper on July 7.

text.p: The New Zealand government will present its white paper on proposals for a compulsory superannuation scheme, or retirement savings scheme (RSS), on July 7, officials said on Tuesday.
A spokesman for the Prime Minister's office told Reuters the white paper would be released at a function at midday that day.
After the release of the Treasury's RSS proposals an intense period of debate and lobbying is expected in the few months before a referendum on the entire concept due in September.

Treasurer Winston Peters, who has championed the idea of privately-funded RSS as part of the political platform of his New Zealand First party, has said that a "No" in the referendum would inevitably put renewed pressure on taxation or age limits in the existing universal superannuation scheme.
